Gemma-2-2B: 100% schema validity with 2% semantic success and 41.7% unsafe acceptance; Qwen3-30B-A3B: 100% schema-valid, ~31% semantic success; GPT-OSS 120B-fast: 100% schema-valid, 81-83% semantic.
